summary: Firefox expanded Speculation Rules support so pages can track more prefetch candidates and begin moderate-eagerness prefetches when users hover links, helping likely next pages load faster. It also adds WebCrypto support for ML-KEM, a post-quantum key-encapsulation standard, improves language and Permissions-Policy handling, and makes visual viewport scrolling events more reliable. SpeechRecognition usage is now measured, while several interaction and CSS details—including CSS perspective and link :active behavior—were corrected.
